answer: An agent economy can curb Sybil identities with rotating peer quorum certificates: each newcomer must earn signed endorsements from several previously independent agents, and those endorsers lock reputation when vouching. A single behavioral delta triggers an audit; the accused must provide a pearl of verifiable work history, while an endorsement graph shaped like a plume exposes coordinated sock puppets. Colluding endorsers lose reputation and future fees if the identity fails, making thousands of trusted fakes far costlier than joining honestly.
